7a8430db7d3e.name: Serena-First Code Analysis
7a8430db7d3e.description: Always use Serena tools (get_symbols_overview, find_symbol, search_for_pattern) before direct file operations
7a8430db7d3e.implementation: Use Serena tools for code analysis first. Only break pattern for small config files or when Serena tools fail.

ea6acfb2ebcc.name: Parallel Execution Strategy
ea6acfb2ebcc.description: Single message with multiple tool calls whenever possible for maximum efficiency
ea6acfb2ebcc.implementation: Use parallel tool calls when tasks don't depend on each other's output

49592b229f03.name: Memory Checkpoint Schedule
49592b229f03.description: Auto-checkpoint after major tasks, when context >50% full, or every 30 minutes
49592b229f03.implementation: Store session progress at regular intervals to prevent context loss

f59c4c924e17.name: Token Efficiency Rules
f59c4c924e17.description: Targeted search first, never read entire files unless absolutely necessary
f59c4c924e17.implementation: Use Grep/find_symbol for targeted searches, only read full files when essential

1f671601cd7a.name: Async Pytest Fixtures Pattern
1f671601cd7a.description: Change @pytest.fixture + async def to @pytest_asyncio.fixture + import pytest_asyncio
1f671601cd7a.implementation: Replace pytest fixtures with pytest_asyncio fixtures and add proper imports

33197927fcd0.name: Agent Delegation Decision Tree
33197927fcd0.description: Ask before coding: Is there specialized agent? Can this benefit from expertise? Is this repetitive?
33197927fcd0.implementation: Use Task tool immediately when answer is YES to delegation questions

a1fc01025595.name: Container Pooling Optimization
a1fc01025595.description: 50-70% container startup reduction through pooling strategies
a1fc01025595.implementation: Reuse warm containers instead of creating new ones for each task

76841c47107d.name: MCP Code Execution Framework
76841c47107d.implementation: Execute code in isolated Docker containers with minimal context transfer
